purpose: One bounded tuning pass separating corrected current-event disocclusion from conservative persistent-history rejection.
invariant: Production architecture 0 remained unchanged during Matrix 24. Mode 14 corrected event veto only; mode 15 additionally preserved compensated intrinsic residual while raw disocclusion still drove history and motion bypass.
interpretation: Matrix 24 proved event/history separation can retain the moving-flash gain without the long trail, but it was a screening run. Inspection of the raw replay fields shows both finalists violate the canonical full-replay fast-pan limit of 0.020: mode 14 measured 0.06747364 and mode 15 measured 0.23253281. Therefore neither is promoted to visual testing. Mode 16 adds a direct whole-frame-motion veto to mode 14 event correction and Matrix 25 evaluates it under the full replay contract.
evidence_serialization: Repository copies are UTF-8 LF JSON serializations of the artifact JSON values.
